entries.title: Array request bodies bypass the body-level validation error
entries.summary: validateCreateInput/validateUpdateInput only reject the whole body (field 'body') when it is falsy or typeof !== 'object'; an array body passes that guard and is validated field-by-field instead.

entries.title: Note titles have no maximum length
entries.summary: validateCreateInput in src/utils/validation.ts accepts a note title of any length on create. It only checks that the title is a string whose trimmed form is non-empty; no maximum-length check exists.

demotions.note: At kb834/p2 HEAD, src/utils/validation.ts has no MAX_TITLE_LENGTH and validateCreateInput has no length check. tests/validation.test.ts now asserts that a 5000-char title is accepted on create. The claim that create rejects titles over 100 characters is false.
